identity.name: Samjhana Ventures
identity.footerBlurb: Where craft meets community, in the hills. Four businesses, one family, one vision.
identity.footerNote: गुल्मीको गर्वका साथ — Proudly from Gulmi

contact.title: Make the stop easy.
contact.copy: Find us in Gulmi, then call or WhatsApp before you set out. We’ll confirm today’s hours, stock, and the easiest route.

visit.title: Come for the journey.
visit.copy: A stop here is part of the journey: fuel for the next climb, a charge while you rest, a mechanic when the bike needs care, and a warm meal before the road opens again.
visit.note: Gulmi मा बाटोको बीचमा भरपर्दो साथ।

shop.title: Take a little home.
shop.copy: Some things begin in the hills and travel home with you: honey from the hives, furniture for daily life, and practical essentials for the road.
shop.note: Browse the story first, then choose the right shop.

featured.title: Made here. Ready for the road.

tiles.title: Honey, bottled with care
tiles.storyTitle: A little of the hillside, carried home.
tiles.storyBody: Maurighar honey begins with local hives, patient seasons, and the work of keeping bees well. Browse the honey collection when you are ready, or ask us which jar is available today.

tiles.title: Furniture for real homes
tiles.storyBody: A table gathers people. A chair waits by the window. Our furniture is chosen for the daily life it will hold, then shaped further when a custom piece makes more sense.

tiles.title: Bike essentials
tiles.storyBody: For bike essentials, send a photo, a part name, or a short list. We will check what is available at Samjhana Ventures and help you choose the practical next step.

tiles.title: Car essentials
tiles.storyTitle: The useful thing you need, when you need it.
tiles.storyBody: Car products do not always fit a neat online category. Tell us what you are looking for and we will confirm availability before you make the trip.

bike.copy: From a quick tyre swap to a deeper engine check, our mechanics help you get moving again. Tap a part of the bike to see how we can help, then call to check today’s availability.
bike.hint: Hover a part · tap on mobile

services.name: Tyre Change
services.story: A quick change when the road has caught up with your tyres.

services.name: Engine Service
services.story: For the deeper check when the bike needs more than a quick adjustment.

services.name: Electrical Fix
services.story: Lights, battery, and electrical issues checked before they become roadside problems.

services.name: Brake Service
services.story: A safety-first stop for brakes that feel soft, noisy, or uncertain.

services.name: Lighting Repair
services.story: Get seen again on early starts, late returns, and mountain roads.

services.name: Free Diagnostics
services.story: Start with a conversation and a practical look at what is wrong.

restaurant.intro: Home-cooked Nepali food made fresh every day. Choose the moment of your journey and we’ll show you the kind of pause waiting at the table.
restaurant.captionNote: Real Nepali food · served warm in Gulmi

meals.label: Breakfast
meals.story: Start early with sel roti, chiura dahi, and a warm cup of tea.

meals.label: Lunch
meals.story: Settle in for dal bhat, dhido, and a proper pause on the highway.

meals.label: Dinner
meals.story: End the day with warm plates, mountain air, and something sweet to drink.

shop.heading: Shop
shop.intro: Honey, beekeeping gear and furniture from the Samjhana Ventures shop in Gulmi.
shop.deliveryNote: We deliver in Gulmi and nearby. We will call you to confirm the delivery time.
shop.pickupNote: Collect from the shop in Gulmi. We will call you when your order is ready.
shop.paymentNote: Pay in cash when your order arrives, or at the shop when you collect it.
shop.customOrderText: Don't see what you need? We build to your exact specifications.
